services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Weddings, birthday parties, company outings, and all kinds of special events are always more fun on a boat! We can accommodate groups of up to 250 on a private cruise in Casco Bay or transportation to an island, with plenty of room for food and entertainment on the way. Casco Bay Lines provides the boat and crew and, if you like, complete bar service; you book a caterer or bring your own food, and hire a band or DJ if you’d like to do a little dancing! See our list of caterers and entertainers who have made past charters memorable. blurb: Casco Bay Lines operates regularly scheduled ferries 365 days a year connecting Portland, Maine to the islands of Casco Bay. They offer passenger, freight, postal, and vehicle ferry services. Specialty cruises and scenic or music cruises are also available.
